scope: Independent private-runtime resolver/cache and distribution instrumentation review
resolved_defect: Fresh Windows PowerShell5.1 source resolver could not find IO.Compression.ZipArchive; explicit System.IO.Compression assembly load added and verified in fresh hosts.

normal_command.layout: PS1 plus tracked resources only, no expanded runtime or portable marker
normal_command.path: genuine module-enabled ImageMagick7.1.2-5 before Windows system paths
normal_command.injection: Existing OutputParent seam only, no MagickPath/PreflightRunner/ProcessRunner

findings: No normal PATH fallback: private selection must succeed or throw; external path is reachable only through the existing internal MagickPath seam.
Recognized package damage is authoritative and cannot fall back to healthy cache; source payload integrity is checked even when cache exists.
Private manifest is pinned in PS1, all runtime files validated and held against write/delete through execution.
Zip entry allowlist, normalized descendant paths, duplicate/link/reparse checks, exclusive sibling extraction and atomic publish preserve fail-closed handling.
Existing self-contained restrictive policy snapshot rules are retained for both bundled and cache selections.

Distribution helper creates genuine .lnk target BAT with quoted source and unrelated Start in; ShellExecuteEx and an inherited private job inspect actual executable paths/hashes/command lines/exits. Direct CMD/BAT propagation is separately tested.
nonblocking_observation: Concurrent losing extraction retains its unique non-executable staging sibling; no cache corruption or fallback arises, but repeated concurrent cold starts may leave unused files.
limitations: Supplemental local review did not block outbound traffic, use a disposable Windows account or claim exact BAT/shortcut processing. Those release gates belong to hosted acceptance.
Instrumentation static review is not execution evidence; actual hosted run must pass.
